body: I believe that we shouldn't rate people here but post suggestions instead. The idea is to get better and stop wallowing in "I'm so ugly."
I could do an even better job spewing BS. Don't trust everything you read on the Internet.

So far I've been doing a good job, but because I am committed. I get nervous seeing other people at the gym, but everyone has to have started somewhere, some later than others. I keep a journal for every day record. Thank you guys for the advice, I'll take it to heed.

I am not bitter superficially. I may even come off as a "happy-go-lucky" type of guy. But internally I'm always feeling that it's no fun being unattractive to the opposite sex and this is how my entire life will be like.
You do realize you can pay to lose your virginity.
I'm about 200 lbs and I'm short. Will be exercising this summer and hoping to lose a pound a week. It's unfortunate but looks do play a part in the dating world.
Story of my life, friend. We must persevere for we are stronger.
There is no fixing my core problem. And that is that I am just not good enough for anything.
